description: Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_commission_act UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/commissions/:id/authority, /measurement or /acceptance); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself and keeps its own free daily limit for one connection. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the wallet that acts. A record moves no NET and holds none, and it posts no job. The program is held off until the operator switches it on; the house pays, holds and sells nothing through this tool. Ask net_commission_status where a work order or reserve stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
